store.title: Pearl Cup Sort
store.short: Sort the smiling pearls until every cup holds one colour.
store.long: A calm colour-sorting puzzle. Each cup holds four pearls; move the top pearl onto a matching one or into an empty cup until every cup is a single colour. Levels start easy and grow to many colours with only a couple of spare cups. Every level can be solved, and finishing in few moves earns three stars.
store.how_to_play: Tap a cup to lift its top pearl, then tap another cup to drop it. A pearl can only land on the same colour or in an empty cup.
store.controls: Mouse or touch: tap the cups.
